title: A Lean proof constructs a maximally entangled state for nine ten-level parties
summary: A formal proof generated with GPT-5.6 Sol constructs a pure state for nine ten-level quantum systems whose reduction to any four is maximally mixed. The exact result concerns existence of an AME(9,10) state.
ai_technology: GPT-5.6 Sol; h1 Lean proof-search harness

source_review.scope: Pinned Atlas Lean theorem and August 28 merge; September Formal Conjectures proof acceptance; h1 Table 1 and Appendix D; follow-up Appendix B.1

evidence.tested: The encoded construction supplies a normalized state and verifies its reductions. The Formal Conjectures maintainer linked the original work, and a later independent paper analyzes the construction.
evidence.unknown: The early maintainer replay exceeded its time limit for this proof. Source review did not include replay. The mathematical construction does not demonstrate hardware preparation.
evidence.ai_role: The h1 harness used GPT-5.6 Sol to generate a proof script with feedback from the Lean 4 checker.
